description: Save a photo of the creator to their likeness library from an HTTPS URL or a data URL, then label it. Always persist any creator photo you use so the next post can reuse it. Real photos are accepted; set is_ai_generated for AI images, which wait as pending for the creator's approval. Never publishes.

data_url.description: PNG, JPEG or WebP data URL.

scene.description: Scene the photo shows, e.g. 'in a coffee shop'.

name: bamf.add_likeness_photo
